title: Keto-friendly German Butter Wrap
description: A light and creamy German dish featuring English muffins, pickle, and a keto-friendly spread.
instructions: Toast two English Muffins until golden brown and slightly crispy. Set aside.
Spread a thin layer of Dijon Mustard on one side of each toasted muffin.
Place a slice of Mozzarella cheese in the center of each mustard-side toast, arranging pickles around it.
Drizzle 2 tablespoons of peanut butter evenly over the top of the fillings.
Return the assembled wraps to the oven for about 3-5 minutes or until the cheese is melted and slightly golden.
Allow to cool for a minute before serving.
